# Amirlan Kalmukhan

> Official machine-readable profile for Amirlan Kalmukhan, also known as Amirlan, @amirlankalm, and @amirlannk.

## Summary

Amirlan Kalmukhan is a 15-year-old co-founder at Geko, building expert-authored training data and real-time audio reinforcement-learning environments for human-like speech models. Previously, he was a founding engineer at Speko (YC S26). He is based in Astana, Kazakhstan.
